phases.name: The Wild West
phases.summary: Borgarnes base for the Snæfellsnes Peninsula and Borgarfjörður geothermal country.

items.title: Snæfellsnes Peninsula Loop
items.desc: Arnarstapi–Hellnar coastal path, Kirkjufell at Grundarfjörður, and optional Gerðuberg basalt cliffs.

items.title: Geothermal Wonders
items.desc: Charger recovery Borgarnes–Reykjavík–Borgarnes on May 4, then Deildartunguhver, Reykholt and Hraunfossar/Barnafoss.

phases.name: Capital of the North
phases.summary: Iceland's second-largest city and the practical hub for Diamond Circle and Mývatn region.

items.title: Akureyri Town Loop
items.desc: Waterfront, botanical gardens, viewpoints, cafés and light walking to keep daily movement goals on track.

items.title: Mývatn & Goðafoss
items.desc: Goðafoss, Lake Mývatn, Hverir/Námafjall, Dimmuborgir, Mývatn Nature Baths, Bjarnaflag and Krafla Power Plant.

phases.name: Golden Circle & Selfoss
phases.summary: Strategic south hub for the Golden Circle circuit and a south-coast preview on arrival.

items.title: Gullfoss, Faxi & Kerið
items.desc: Gullfoss waterfall, Faxi (Vatnsleysufoss) cascades, and Kerið volcanic crater on May 10.

items.title: South Coast Preview
items.desc: Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss and Reynisfjara Black Sand Beach on the May 9 arrival run from Akureyri.

phases.name: The Big East Run
phases.summary: Out-and-back day from Hvolsvöllur to Jökulsárlón — same Route 1 south coast road each way.

items.title: Jökulsárlón & Diamond Beach
items.desc: 5:30am start with Urriðafoss en route; Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon, seals and Diamond Beach ice on black sand.

items.title: Return via South Coast
items.desc: Same Route 1 back west: Reynisfjara basalt columns, Skógafoss Fimmvörðuháls hike, Kvernufoss, back to Hvolsvöllur.

phases.name: Return to Reykjavík
phases.summary: Short return to the capital, a Snæfellsnes day trip and three days of Reykjavík exploration.

items.title: Hvolsvöllur → Reykjavík + Garður
items.desc: Route 1 west, Garður Old Lighthouse on Reykjanes Peninsula, Hallgrímskirkja and Harpa on arrival.

items.title: Snæfellsnes Day Trip (Walter Mitty Bridge)
items.desc: Stykkishólmur harbour, Kirkjufell, Arnarstapi/Hellnar coastal walk, Reykjavík evening.

turns.title: May 4 recovery rule
turns.text: Because the charger recovery adds a Borgarnes–Reykjavík–Borgarnes round trip, keep May 4 to the Borgarfjörður geothermal loop after returning and move the full Snæfellsnes loop to May 5.

turns.title: Reykjavík → Borgarnes
turns.text: Leave Reykjavík on Route 1 / Vesturlandsvegur through the Hvalfjörður tunnel corridor to Borgarnes.

turns.title: Borgarnes → Snæfellsnes loop
turns.text: From Borgarnes, use Route 54 west toward Snæfellsnes. For Arnarstapi/Hellnar, turn onto Route 574; continue around to Grundarfjörður/Kirkjufell, then return east via Route 54/56 toward Borgarfjörður.

turns.title: Borgarfjörður geothermal detour
turns.text: Use Route 50/518 area for Deildartunguhver, Kleppjárnsreykir and Reykholt, then rejoin Route 1 for the northbound drive.

turns.title: Borgarnes/Borgarfjörður → Akureyri
turns.text: Follow Route 1 north and east across West/North Iceland to Akureyri. This is a long repositioning leg; charge/fuel before departure and again near major towns.

turns.title: Akureyri → Goðafoss → Mývatn
turns.text: Stay on Route 1 east from Akureyri. Goðafoss is just off Route 1; continue to Reykjahlíð/Mývatn, then return to Akureyri by Route 1.

turns.title: Akureyri → Selfoss
turns.text: Long southbound repositioning via Route 1 through the west/north corridor, then south to Selfoss. Treat this as a transit day with weather buffers.

turns.title: Golden Circle from Selfoss
turns.text: Use Route 35/36/37/35 circuit depending direction: Selfoss → Þingvellir → Geysir → Gullfoss → back toward Hveragerði/Selfoss. Check exact navigation before leaving because several Golden Circle roads interconnect.

turns.title: Reykjadalur
turns.text: From Selfoss, drive west on Route 1 to Hveragerði and use the Reykjadalur trailhead parking area; hike only if trail and weather conditions are good.

turns.title: Selfoss → Waterfall Way
turns.text: Drive east on Route 1. Turn north on Route 249 / Þórsmerkurvegur for Seljalandsfoss and Gljúfrabúi, return to Route 1, then continue east to Skógafoss.

turns.title: Black sands and Vík/Klaustur
turns.text: From Route 1, use Route 218 for Dyrhólaey and Route 215 for Reynisfjara, then continue east through Vík and lava/sandur landscapes toward Kirkjubæjarklaustur and Skaftafell.

turns.title: Glacier lagoon → Höfn / Breiðdalsvík
turns.text: Continue east on Route 1 from Skaftafell to Jökulsárlón and Diamond Beach, then Höfn and the East Fjords corridor toward Breiðdalsvík.

turns.title: Return to Reykjavík
turns.text: The mapped return from Breiðdalsvík follows the practical south-coast Route 1 return. Build in a large buffer, or break it overnight if weather/energy are poor.

days.title: Arrive Reykjavík → Borgarnes
days.plan: Pick up vehicle, stock supplies, drive Route 1 to Borgarnes base camp.

days.title: Charger recovery + Borgarfjörður geothermal loop
days.drive: ~152 km charger round trip + ~119 km local loop
days.plan: Drive Borgarnes–Reykjavík–Borgarnes for the laptop charger. Afternoon: Deildartunguhver, Reykholt and Hraunfossar/Barnafoss.

days.title: Snæfellsnes Peninsula loop
days.plan: Arnarstapi–Hellnar coastal path, Kirkjufell/Grundarfjörður, optional Gerðuberg basalt cliffs.

days.title: Borgarnes → Akureyri via Varmahlíð
days.plan: Route 1 north/east transit day via Varmahlíð. Settle in Akureyri; evening town walk, harbour, Forest Lagoon.

days.title: Goðafoss, Mývatn & geothermal fields
days.plan: Goðafoss, Lake Mývatn, Hverir/Námafjall, Dimmuborgir, Mývatn Nature Baths.

days.title: Bjarnaflag + Krafla → begin south drive
days.plan: Bjarnaflag Power Station and Krafla Power Plant, then begin the long southbound repositioning.

days.title: Akureyri → Selfoss + south coast preview
days.plan: Weather forced direct Route 1 south. On arrival: Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss, Reynisfjara Black Sand Beach, then overnight Selfoss.

days.title: Selfoss — Golden Circle day
days.plan: Gullfoss, Faxi (Vatnsleysufoss), Kerið volcanic crater. Afternoon: LÁ Art Museum and Greenhouse Café (Hveragerði), Húsið Museum (Eyrarbakki).

days.title: The Big East Run — Hvolsvöllur ↔ Jökulsárlón
days.plan: 5:30am depart. Urriðafoss stop, Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon and Diamond Beach. Return via Reynisfjara and Skógafoss (Fimmvörðuháls trail + Kvernufoss). Back by 5pm.

days.title: Hvolsvöllur → Reykjavík + Garður Lighthouse
days.plan: Lava Centre morning, Route 1 west. Garður Old Lighthouse detour on Reykjanes. Afternoon: Hallgrímskirkja, Harpa. Evening: Old Harbour dinner.

days.title: Snæfellsnes Day Trip — Walter Mitty Bridge
days.plan: Reykjavík → Stykkishólmur (Walter Mitty bridge, harbour) → Kirkjufell → Arnarstapi/Hellnar coastal walk → back to Reykjavík by 6pm.

days.title: Reykjavík City Day
days.plan: National Museum, Perlan ice cave, Settlement Exhibition, Laugavegur, Tjörnin Pond. Evening: live jazz or blues at Harpa/Húrra.
